The compiler classifies the zero-width quantified body using the memory-aware helper protected by the feature macro.
The capture container is marked as empty-memory, producing the dangerous classification the bug hinges on.
Compilation emits the empty-check bytecode variant that consults memory-state bookkeeping during matching.
At runtime, the matcher reads the empty-check bookkeeping and traverses stack memory that can be stale in the vulnerable scenario.

note: This is the sink: the compiled empty-repeat/backreference pattern is executed and can surface the heap-use-after-free read.
